successors.name: Thakuri dynasty
successors.text: the Kathmandu Valley, with settlement east toward Banepa, west toward Tistung Deurali and northwest toward Gorkha

capitals.name: Kathmandu Valley (Licchavi court; Kailashkut Bhawan at Hadigaun under Amshuvarman)

ledger.x: 464: the earliest dated record of the Licchavi kingdom of Nepal.
879: Licchavi rule gives way to the Thakuris.

wars.name: Narendradeva's restoration
wars.outcome: After the ouster of Narendradeva's father "in around 624", the family fled to Tibet; Narendradeva "with the Tibetan Empire's help, reclaimed his ancestral throne from them in around 643" and sent envoys to China (Wang Xuance, c.

certainty.note: No frontier is given on any page; only the Kathmandu Valley is certain.
